message.content:
Here are the best websites to find **free 3D game assets** (models, textures, animations, and more) for your game development projects:

---

## 🎮 All-Rounders (Multiple Asset Types)

### **Kenney** — [https://kenney.nl](https://kenney.nl)
- Over **40,000 assets** — all **CC0** (public domain)
- 2D sprites, 3D models, UI elements, fonts, audio
- Clean, consistent art style perfect for prototyping
- No sign-up required

### **itch.io (Free Game Assets)** — [https://itch.io/game-assets/free](https://itch.io/game-assets/free)
- Thousands of free asset packs from indie creators
- Filter by asset type, art style, and license
- Many CC0 packs available; licenses vary by creator

### **OpenGameArt.org** — [https://opengameart.org](https://opengameart.org)
- Community-driven site with over a decade of contributions
- 2D art, 3D models, music, sound effects
- Open licenses (CC0, CC-BY, GPL)

---

## 🧊 3D Models

### **Quaternius** — [https://quaternius.com](https://quaternius.com)
- Thousands of **stylized low-poly 3D models**
- Characters, animals, vehicles, environments, weapons
- All **CC0** — rigged and animated
- Ready for Unity, Unreal, Godot

### **Poly Haven** — [https://polyhaven.com](https://polyhaven.com)
- High-quality **3D models, HDRIs, and textures**
- All **CC0**, no sign-up required
- Best for realistic props and environment art

### **Meshy AI** — [https://www.meshy.ai/tags/game](https://www.meshy.ai/tags/game)
- **6,870+ free game 3D models** in STL, GLB, FBX, OBJ formats
- AI-generated assets with PBR textures
- Free for commercial use (CC0)

### **PolyScann** — [https://polyscann.com/assets](https://polyscann.com/assets)
- Free **CC0 3D assets** optimized for Unity
- Buildings, medieval props, industrial assets
- Game-ready topology with PBR textures
- Compatible with Built-in, URP, and HDRP pipelines

### **Sketchfab (Free Section)** — [https://sketchfab.com](https://sketchfab.com)
- Massive library with free downloadable models
- Filter by "Downloadable" and check licenses
- Built-in 3D viewer to inspect before downloading

### **Open3DModel** — [https://open3dmodel.com](https://open3dmodel.com)
- Hundreds of free game-themed 3D models
- Categories: game characters, environments, beasts, consoles
- Multiple formats: .Blend, .FBX, .OBJ, .Max, etc.

### **TurboSquid** — [https://www.turbosquid.com/Search/3D-Models/game](https://www.turbosquid.com/Search/3D-Models/game)
- 174,000+ game 3D models (free and premium)
- FBX, OBJ, Blender, Maya, rigged, animated, low-poly

---

## 🎨 Textures & Materials

### **ambientCG** — [https://ambientcg.com](https://ambientcg.com)
- **2,000+ PBR materials, HDRIs, and 3D models**
- All **CC0** — free for commercial use without attribution
- Up to 8K resolution with albedo, normal, roughness, metallic, height, AO maps

### **CGBookcase** — [https://cgbookcase.com](https://cgbookcase.com)
- High-quality **PBR textures** (brick, stone, natural materials)
- All free with no usage restrictions
- Includes tutorials for Unreal Engine and Blender

### **FreeStylized** — [https://freestylized.com](https://freestylized.com)
- 150+ **stylized 4K textures** for game devs
- Game-ready asset packs with LODs for Unity, Unreal, Godot
- Skyboxes/HDRI up to 8K resolution

---

## 🏃 Characters & Animations

### **Mixamo** — [https://www.mixamo.com](https://www.mixamo.com)
- Adobe's free library of **rigged characters and motion-capture animations**
- Walks, runs, combat, idles, dances, gestures
- Free for commercial use, no royalties or attribution
- Auto-rigging for custom characters

---

## ⚡ Quick Reference Table

| Site | Asset Types | License | Best For |
|------|-------------|---------|----------|
| Kenney | 2D, 3D, UI, Audio | CC0 | Rapid prototyping, consistent style |
| Quaternius | 3D Models | CC0 | Low-poly stylized games |
| Poly Haven | 3D, Textures, HDRI | CC0 | Realistic environments |
| ambientCG | PBR Textures, HDRI | CC0 | Realistic materials |
| Mixamo | Characters, Animations | Free commercial | Rigged characters, mocap |
| PolyScann | 3D Models | CC0 | Unity-ready game assets |
| Meshy AI | AI-Generated 3D | CC0 | Quick custom assets |

---

**💡 Tip:** Always check the specific license for each asset before using it commercially. **CC0** means no attribution required; **CC-BY** requires credit.
